speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) what data has the Ministry obtained regarding the quantitative impact on earnings faced by hawkers due to inflation in electricity and ingredient prices and restrictions on dining-in; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider additional support measures to cushion the impact on (i) hawkers and (ii) low-income groups who rely on affordable hawker food.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Some hawkers have shared that they have been affected by the rising prices of electricity and key ingredients, such as cooking oil and eggs, caused by the disruption of global supply chains and food production and the Ukraine war.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Hawkers were also affected by the restrictions on dining-in due to COVID-19.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Nevertheless, we are constantly monitoring the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and the global situation on hawkers and have been providing various forms of support.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: As announced at Budget 2022, the Government will be providing further support under the Small Business Recovery Grant this year.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Eligible hawkers will be notified by IRAS from June 2022 onwards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: This will provide some support to our hawkers during this period of inflationary pressure.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Hawkers who continue to face financial difficulties can approach NEA or MSF for assistance.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The Government recognises the impact of rising costs on low-income families.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Families who need support for their basic living expenses can approach MSF’s Social Service Offices (SSOs).

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The SSOs will continue to exercise flexibility when providing ComCare assistance to help households cope with their daily living expenses, such as food costs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The five Community Development Councils (CDCs) will also be launching the CDC Vouchers Scheme again.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: This is one of the schemes announced at Budget 2022 to support Singaporean families in managing their daily expenses under the 2022 Household Support Package.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The Government will continue to monitor and review the impact of inflationary pressures on businesses’ operating costs and citizens’ cost of living.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The Minister for Finance and Second Minister for Trade and Industry will also be delivering a Joint Ministerial Statement on inflation and business costs at this Parliament Sitting.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: The hawkers who operate in privately-run hawker centres usually cannot get the benefit of rental waivers and other levers of control the Government has.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Would the Government look more on the problems they face from rising food costs and see how that can be addressed?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Lastly, given the spike in food prices because of geopolitical events and so on, and these will take some time to stabilise, will the Government consider a freezing of upward revisions to the rentals, at least for a certain period of time until the situation stabilises?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: With regard to the last question about rental revision, let me share that we had frozen rental revision for a period when we had the dining restrictions.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, in fact, with rental revisions, actually, many of the hawkers are assisted because they are revised to assess market rent which takes into account current market conditions.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: With regard to the private sector stallholders, in fact, the Small Business Recovery Grant would also apply to them if they have employees under CPF contributions, for instance.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: And, in fact, if they are in HDB rental units and so on, there were previously also help given in terms of rental revisions or waivers.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: Food vouchers for the lower income to spend at hawker centres.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: The CDC Voucher can be used at participating hawker stalls and coffee shops, and so on.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Many of us, in our own constituencies, provide our own food vouchers or grocery vouchers.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon, you have a clarification?

speaker: Mr Speaker
